surprises.what: Period pointers carry a rev counter (not in architecture.md Contracts "Table items") so each pointer write is conditional on the version read; the condition language cannot compare the history list. Not a D-n change. Proposal for the planner: add rev (integer, bumped on every pointer write) to the Period pointer row.
